definition.en: A body turning about its own axis, an imaginary line through it.
definition.zh: 天体绕自身的假想轴线转动。

definition.en: A body travelling around another body.
definition.zh: 一个天体围绕另一个天体运行。

definition.en: The angle between Earth’s spin axis and a line perpendicular to its orbital plane.
definition.zh: 地球自转轴与轨道平面垂线的夹角。

definition.en: Half of a sphere. Earth’s equator divides its northern and southern hemispheres.
definition.zh: 球体的一半。赤道把地球分成南北半球。

definition.en: How long the Sun is above the horizon, using the chosen rule for sunrise and sunset.
definition.zh: 按选定的日出日落规则，太阳在地平线上方的时长。

definition.en: The time from one return of the Sun to the same daily position to the next.
definition.zh: 太阳从一个日常位置回到同一位置所需的时间。

definition.en: When the Sun crosses the local north–south line in the sky and reaches its highest daily position.
definition.zh: 太阳经过当地天空的南北子午线、到达当天最高位置的时刻。

definition.en: The shape of the Moon’s sunlit part that we see from Earth.
definition.zh: 从地球看见的月球受光部分的形状。

definition.en: Turning once while completing one orbit. This keeps nearly the same side of the Moon facing Earth.
definition.zh: 公转一周时自转一周，让月球近似同一面朝向地球。

definition.en: The time from one new Moon to the next.
definition.zh: 从一次新月到下一次新月的时间。

definition.en: A place where the Moon’s orbit crosses Earth’s orbital plane.
definition.zh: 月球轨道穿过地球轨道平面的位置。

definition.en: When the Moon blocks some or all of the Sun for an observer.
definition.zh: 月球为观察者遮住部分或全部太阳的现象。

definition.en: When the Moon moves into Earth’s shadow.
A solar eclipse in which the Moon looks smaller than the Sun and leaves a bright ring around it.
definition.zh: 月球看起来比太阳小，遮住中央后仍露出太阳亮环的日食。

definition.en: How wide a body looks from a chosen place, measured as an angle.
definition.zh: 从指定地点看，天体所占的角宽度。

definition.en: A calendar that uses both lunar months and solar-year information.
definition.zh: 结合月相月份和太阳年信息的历法。
